site_description: Indie developer building thoughtful, useful tools for the web.
hero_title: Building thoughtful tools, one small idea at a time.
hero_subtitle: I design and ship opinionated software, from prompt-management platforms to audio-reactive visuals. Most of it starts as a tiny itch and grows in public.
section_about_title_secondary: You can also call me yuhan
about_fallback_bio: I'm an indie developer who likes building small, opinionated tools, usually around AI tooling, prompt management, and creative coding. Most of my work is open-source.
about_work_note: I work mostly with TypeScript, React, and Postgres. When I'm not shipping side projects, I'm reading papers, testing new ideas, or looking for a good quiet café.
